_note: Real photographs downloaded from Wikimedia Commons on 2026-11-07 for testing the SENTINEL Vision Agent. These are ONLINE_REFERENCE images, not photographs captured by SENTINEL. capture_timestamp is null because SENTINEL did not capture them; source_reported_date is what the source page states. visibly_observable / cannot_be_confirmed were written by a human reviewer from the images themselves and are not defect ground truth.

images.description: A couple of managed D-Link Gigabit Ethernet rackmount switches, connected to the Ethernet ports on a few Panduit patch panels using Category 6 patch cables (all equipment is installed in a standard 19-inch rack)
visibly_observable: Open rack with two patch panels (top), a keystone-style panel, two rack-mount switches labelled D-Link Web Smart Switch, and a Cisco-branded device on a shelf at the bottom
Many grey/white patch cables routed through horizontal cable managers in neat loops
Green/amber LEDs on the left side of both switches
Some patch-panel and keystone ports have no cable plugged in
Small orange/red light at the top right of the rack frame
cannot_be_confirmed: Which device any cable connects to
Meaning of any LED colour without the manufacturer documentation
